WITH month_dates AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT d_date_sk, d_date
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_month_seq BETWEEN 1212 AND 1212 + 11
),
web_cume AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT ws.ws_item_sk AS item_sk,
           md.d_date AS d_date,
           SUM(SUM(ws.ws_sales_price)) OVER (
               PARTITION BY ws.ws_item_sk
               ORDER BY md.d_date
               ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
           ) AS cume_sales
    FROM month_dates md
    JOIN web_sales ws
      ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = md.d_date_sk
     AND ws.ws_item_sk IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY ws.ws_item_sk, md.d_date
),
store_cume AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT ss.ss_item_sk AS item_sk,
           md.d_date AS d_date,
           SUM(SUM(ss.ss_sales_price)) OVER (
               PARTITION BY ss.ss_item_sk
               ORDER BY md.d_date
               ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
           ) AS cume_sales
    FROM month_dates md
    JOIN store_sales ss
      ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = md.d_date_sk
     AND ss.ss_item_sk IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY ss.ss_item_sk, md.d_date
),
combined_daily AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT item_sk,
           d_date,
           MAX(web_sales) AS web_sales,
           MAX(store_sales) AS store_sales
    FROM (
        SELECT item_sk,
               d_date,
               cume_sales AS web_sales,
               NULL AS store_sales
        FROM web_cume
        UNION ALL
        SELECT item_sk,
               d_date,
               NULL AS web_sales,
               cume_sales AS store_sales
        FROM store_cume
    ) sales_rows
    GROUP BY item_sk, d_date
),
final_window AS (
    SELECT item_sk,
           d_date,
           web_sales,
           store_sales,
           MAX(web_sales) OVER w AS web_cumulative,
           MAX(store_sales) OVER w AS store_cumulative
    FROM combined_daily
    WINDOW w AS (
        PARTITION BY item_sk
        ORDER BY d_date
        ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    )
)
SELECT item_sk,
       d_date,
       web_sales,
       store_sales,
       web_cumulative,
       store_cumulative
FROM final_window
WHERE web_cumulative > store_cumulative
ORDER BY item_sk, d_date
LIMIT 100
